title: Interlock Logic & Cause Effect Matrix - YD-2301 (SEQ-5500)
content:
INTERLOCK LOGIC & CAUSE EFFECT MATRIX: SEQ-5500 (DRYER SYSTEM (YD-2301) SHUTDOWN LOGIC).
Document No: TJC-LLD-IL-YD-2301, Revision: Rev 3, SIL Level: SIL 2.
Equipment: YD-2301, Functional Location: TJC-LLD-2300-01.
CAUSE & EFFECT MATRIX (TRIPS):
- T1: Outlet temperature HIGH-HIGH (TSHH-2301 > 125 degC, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Close (EFF-2), Annunciate (EFF-5)
- T2: Nitrogen purge flow LOW-LOW (FSLL-2302 < 200 kg/h, 2oo3) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Close (EFF-2), Trip (EFF-3), Annunciate (EFF-5)
- T3: Inlet chute level HIGH-HIGH (LSHH-2303 > 90 %, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-3), Annunciate (EFF-5)
- T4: Drum speed LOW-LOW (chain slip) (SSLL-2305 < 1 rpm, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Annunciate (EFF-5)
- T5: Vent O2 HIGH-HIGH (ASHH-2307 > 8 % O2, 1oo2) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Close (EFF-2), Open (EFF-4), Annunciate (EFF-5)
- T6: Drive motor overload (MPR-2301 MPR pickup, 1oo1) -> Actions: Trip (EFF-1), Close (EFF-2), Annunciate (EFF-5)
START PERMISSIVES (AND-gate conditions to start pump):
- P1: Nitrogen inerting established (O2 < 5%) (AT-2307, Gate Logic: AND)
- P2: Steam condensate drain open (ZSO-2304, Gate Logic: AND)
- P3: Lube oil to gearbox OK (PSL-2306, Gate Logic: AND)
- P4: No active trip / reset done (DCS reset, Gate Logic: AND)
- —: ALL permissives TRUE → START YD-2301 ENABLED (—, Gate Logic: AND)
CROSS REFERENCES: P&ID: TJC-LLD-PID-2301, Datasheet: TJC-LLD-DS-YD-2301.
